description: Call first if you are new to Rightshold. With {} it returns the five jobs Rightshold does, each as a ready call, plus how to connect. Add {"license": "CC-BY-NC-4.0", "use": "commercial_use"} or {"question": "Can I train a model on MIT code?"} and the same call answers it. Free, no key.

license.description: Optional: an SPDX id to check right away, e.g. CC-BY-NC-4.0

question.description: Optional: a rights question in plain English, answered in the same call

use.description: Optional: the use to check the license for (default commercial_use)

name: start_here
title: Start here: what Rightshold can check for you
